name: input-validation
description: Always validate and sanitize user input at system boundaries to prevent injection attacks
author: community
content:
## Input Validation

All user input must be validated and sanitized at system boundaries.

### Rules
- Validate type, length, format, and range of all inputs
- Use allowlists over denylists when possible
- Sanitize HTML output to prevent XSS
- Use parameterized queries for all database operations — never string concatenation
- Validate file uploads: type, size, and content
- Reject unexpected fields in API payloads
- Use a validation library (Zod, Joi, class-validator) rather than manual checks

### Common Patterns
- URLs: validate protocol (https only), domain allowlist
- Email: use proper email validation, not just regex
- Numbers: check for NaN, Infinity, negative values
- Strings: max length, allowed characters, no null bytes
